component.name: Ari
component.summary: Ask Luma's assistant, or tell her what to change

description.p: Ari answers questions and changes personal settings like the dock, the theme and the wallpaper. Every change shows as a step you can undo.
Ari runs an open model on this computer. Conversations and the activity log stay here, and what she reads on the web can inform an answer but never make a change.
